candidates.title: The Compass That Pointed to the Wall
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the museum's navigation compass pointed at a wall instead of north before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but the guide moved the compass to a different table but it still pointed sideways; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a powerful magnetic display mount was hidden inside the nearby exhibit wall; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they moved the compass outside the magnetic field and demonstrated the difference, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Wheel That Turned Backward
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the garden waterwheel spun backward after the irrigation channel was repaired before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but the gardeners increased the water flow but the wheel spun backward even faster; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the repaired channel discharged water on the opposite side of the wheel; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they redirected the flow through the intended chute and checked the wheel safely, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Kite That Shook in a Clear Sky
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the festival kite vibrated violently despite a steady breeze before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but the flyers shortened the main string but the shaking did not stop; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a newly attached decorative tail oscillated at the same rhythm as the kite frame; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they replaced the tail with a balanced design and tested the kite in a clear area, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
